async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Set the Period to 'Year' to aggregate data annually for broader coverage
    await page.get_by_role("group", name="Filter").get_by_role("combobox", name="Period").select_option("Year")
    # Wait for UI to update
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Set the From date to a past date to cover all history
    from_input = page.get_by_role("group", name="Filter").get_by_role("textbox", name="From * This is a required field.")
    await from_input.fill("01/01/2000")
    # Set the To date to a future date to include up to now
    to_input = page.get_by_role("group", name="Filter").get_by_role("textbox", name="To * This is a required field.")
    await to_input.fill("12/31/2030")
    # Click 'Show Report' to apply the updated filters
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Show Report").click()
    # Wait for the report to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(3)
    # Extract and print the text from the main content area to get the report data as-is
    report_text = await page.get_by_role("main").inner_text()
    print(report_text)

async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Set the Period to 'Year' to aggregate data annually for broader coverage
    await page.get_by_role("group", name="Filter").get_by_role("combobox", name="Period").select_option("Year")
    # Wait for UI to update
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Set the From date to a past date to cover all history
    from_input = page.get_by_role("group", name="Filter").get_by_role("textbox", name="From * This is a required field.")
    await from_input.fill("01/01/2000")
    # Set the To date to a future date to include up to now
    to_input = page.get_by_role("group", name="Filter").get_by_role("textbox", name="To * This is a required field.")
    await to_input.fill("12/31/2030")
    # Click 'Show Report' to apply the updated filters
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Show Report").click()
    # Wait for the report to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(3)
    # Extract and print the text from the main content area to get the report data as-is
    report_text = await page.get_by_role("main").inner_text()
    print(report_text)
    return report_text
